   298	    try:
   299	        parsed = json.loads(checks_json or "[]")
   300	    except json.JSONDecodeError:

   302	    rows = _parse_check_rows(parsed)
   303	    if not rows:

   305	    if required:
   306	        pending = [row for row in rows if row.get("bucket") == "pending"]
   307	        if pending:

   309	        failed = [row for row in rows if row.get("bucket") == "fail"]
   310	        if failed:
   311	            return "fail", _row_run_id(failed[0])
   312	        non_pass = [row for row in rows if row.get("bucket") != "pass"]
   313	        if non_pass:
   314	            return "fail", _row_run_id(non_pass[0])
   315	        return "pass", None
   316	    failed = [row for row in rows if row.get("bucket") == "fail"]
   317	    pending = [row for row in rows if row.get("bucket") == "pending"]
   318	    if failed:
   319	        return "fail", _row_run_id(failed[0])
   320	    if pending:

   338	def _classify_checks_text(text: str, *, required: bool = False) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
   339	    if not text.strip():
   340	        return "empty", None
   341	    if required:
   342	        fail_re = (
   343	            r"\b(fail(?:ed|ure|ing)?|error|cancel(?:led|ed)?|skip(?:ped|ping)?|"
   344	            r"unknown|timed?\s*out|action\s+required|neutral|stale)\b"
   345	        )
   346	        pending_re = r"\b(pending|in_progress|in progress|queued|waiting|requested|expected)\b"
   347	        pass_re = r"\b(pass(?:ed|ing)?|success(?:ful)?|succeed(?:ed)?|completed)\b"
   348	    else:
   349	        fail_re = r"\bfail"
   350	        pending_re = r"\b(pending|in_progress|in progress|queued)\b"
   351	        pass_re = r"\b(pass(?:ed|ing)?|success(?:ful)?|succeed(?:ed)?|completed)\b"
   352	
   353	    lines = [line for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]
   354	
   355	    def _classify_field(line: str) -> str:
   356	        return _pr_checks_text_status_field(line) if required else line
   357	
   358	    failed_line = next(
   359	        (line for line in lines if re.search(fail_re, _classify_field(line), flags=re.IGNORECASE)),
   360	        "",
   361	    )
   362	    if failed_line:
   363	        link_match = re.search(r"https://\S+", failed_line)
   364	        run_id = _extract_run_id(link_match.group(0)) if link_match else None
   365	        return "fail", run_id
   366	    if any(re.search(pending_re, _classify_field(line), flags=re.IGNORECASE) for line in lines):
   367	        return "pending", None
   368	    if required and not any(
   369	        re.search(pass_re, _classify_field(line), flags=re.IGNORECASE) for line in lines
   370	    ):
   371	        return "fail", None
   372	    return "pass", None

   395	def _resolve_checks_status(
   396	    runner: Runner,
   397	    *,
   398	    pr: int,
   399	    repo: str,
   400	    empty_checks_grace: int,
   401	    sleep_fn: SleepFn,
   402	    cwd: str | None,
   403	    required: bool = False,
   404	) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
   405	    """Classify PR checks with JSON-first and text fallback (ci-status.sh parity)."""
   406	    checks = _gh_pr_checks(runner, pr=pr, repo=repo, cwd=cwd, required=required)
   407	    checks_json = _checks_json_from_result(checks)
   408	
   409	    if _checks_json_is_array(checks_json):
   410	        bucket_status, run_id = _classify_checks_json(checks_json, required=required)
   411	        if bucket_status == "empty" and empty_checks_grace > 0:
   412	            sleep_fn(float(empty_checks_grace))
   413	            checks = _gh_pr_checks(runner, pr=pr, repo=repo, cwd=cwd, required=required)
   414	            checks_json = _checks_json_from_result(checks)
   415	            if _checks_json_is_array(checks_json):
   416	                bucket_status, run_id = _classify_checks_json(checks_json, required=required)
   417	        if bucket_status == "empty":
   418	            text = _read_pr_checks_text(runner, pr=pr, repo=repo, cwd=cwd, required=required)
   419	            if text.strip():
   420	                return _classify_checks_text(text, required=required)
   421	            return ("NO_CHECKS", None) if empty_checks_grace > 0 else ("pending", None)
   422	        return bucket_status, run_id
   423	
   424	    text = _read_pr_checks_text(runner, pr=pr, repo=repo, cwd=cwd, required=required)
   425	    if not text.strip() and empty_checks_grace > 0:
   426	        sleep_fn(float(empty_checks_grace))
   427	        text = _read_pr_checks_text(runner, pr=pr, repo=repo, cwd=cwd, required=required)
   428	    if text.strip():
   429	        return _classify_checks_text(text, required=required)
   430	    if empty_checks_grace > 0:
   431	        return "NO_CHECKS", None
   432	    return "pending", None

   457	def gather_status(
   458	    runner: Runner,
   459	    *,
   460	    pr: int,
   461	    repo: str,
   462	    base_remote: str = "origin",
   463	    base_ref: str = "main",
   464	    empty_checks_grace: int = 0,
   465	    sleep_fn: SleepFn = time.sleep,
   466	    cwd: str | None = None,
   467	    required: bool = False,
   468	) -> CiStatus:
   469	    """Port of ci-status.sh."""
   470	    conflicted = True
   471	    pr_view_ok = True
   472	    try:
   473	        pr_info = gh.pr_view(runner, pr, repo=repo, cwd=cwd)
   474	    except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-except
   475	        pr_info = None
   476	        pr_view_ok = False
   477	    if pr_info is not None:
   478	        if pr_info.state.upper() == "MERGED":
   479	            return CiStatus(status="merged", behind_count=0, failed_run_id=None, conflicted=False)
   480	        conflicted = _conflicted_from_merge_state(pr_info.merge_state_status)
   481	
   482	    fetch = git.fetch(runner, base_remote, base_ref, cwd=cwd)
   483	    if fetch.returncode != 0:
   484	        return CiStatus(status="pending", behind_count=0, failed_run_id=None, conflicted=conflicted)
   485	
   486	    status, failed_run_id = checks_status(
   487	        runner,
   488	        pr=pr,
   489	        repo=repo,
   490	        empty_checks_grace=empty_checks_grace,
   491	        sleep_fn=sleep_fn,
   492	        cwd=cwd,
   493	        required=required,
   494	    )
   495	
   496	    behind_raw = _behind_count(
   497	        runner,
   498	        base_remote=base_remote,
   499	        base_ref=base_ref,
   500	        cwd=cwd,
   501	    )
   502	    if behind_raw is None:
   503	        return CiStatus(
   504	            status=status,
   505	            behind_count=0,
   506	            failed_run_id=failed_run_id,
   507	            conflicted=conflicted,
   508	            pr_view_ok=pr_view_ok,
   509	        )
   510	    behind = behind_raw
   511	    if behind > 0 and _squash_merge_race(
   512	        runner,
   513	        pr=pr,
   514	        base_remote=base_remote,
   515	        base_ref=base_ref,
   516	        cwd=cwd,
   517	    ):
   518	        return CiStatus(status="merged", behind_count=0, failed_run_id=None, conflicted=False)
   519	    return CiStatus(
   520	        status=status,
   521	        behind_count=behind,
   522	        failed_run_id=failed_run_id,
   523	        conflicted=conflicted,
   524	        pr_view_ok=pr_view_ok,
   525	    )

   528	def poll_ci(
   529	    runner: Runner,
   530	    *,
   531	    pr: int,
   532	    repo: str,
   533	    base_remote: str,
   534	    base_ref: str,
   535	    empty_checks_grace: int,
   536	    iteration: int,
   537	    rebase_count: int,
   538	    fix_attempts: int,
   539	    timeout: float = config.CI_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC,
   540	    sleep_fn: SleepFn = time.sleep,
   541	    clock: ClockFn = time.monotonic,
   542	    cwd: str | None = None,
   543	    required: bool = False,  # Callers that restrict to required checks must pass required=True.
   544	) -> tuple[CiStatus, Decision]:
   545	    """Port of ci-wait.sh poll loop."""
   546	    max_polls = max(1, math.ceil(timeout / config.CI_WAIT_POLL_INTERVAL_SEC))
   547	    checks = 0
   548	    ci_failures = 0
   549	    poll_interval = float(config.CI_WAIT_POLL_INTERVAL_SEC)
   550	    started_at = clock()
   551	    last_status = CiStatus(status="pending", behind_count=0, failed_run_id=None)
   552	
   553	    while True:
   554	        if checks >= max_polls:
   555	            return (
   556	                last_status,
   557	                Decision(
   558	                    action="bail",
   559	                    bail_reason=config.CI_WAIT_BAIL_POLL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED,
   560	                ),
   561	            )
   562	
   563	        status = gather_status(
   564	            runner,
   565	            pr=pr,
   566	            repo=repo,
   567	            base_remote=base_remote,
   568	            base_ref=base_ref,
   569	            empty_checks_grace=empty_checks_grace,
   570	            sleep_fn=sleep_fn,
   571	            cwd=cwd,
   572	            required=required,
   573	        )
   574	
   575	        if not status.status or status.status == "error":
   576	            ci_failures += 1
   577	            if ci_failures >= config.CI_MONITOR_STATUS_FAILURE_BAIL:
   578	                return (
   579	                    CiStatus(status="error", behind_count=0, failed_run_id=None),
   580	                    Decision(
   581	                        action="bail",
   582	                        bail_reason=config.CI_WAIT_BAIL_STATUS_STALE,
   583	                    ),
   584	                )
   585	            status = CiStatus(
   586	                status="pending",
   587	                behind_count=status.behind_count,
   588	                failed_run_id=status.failed_run_id,
   589	                conflicted=status.conflicted,
   590	                pr_view_ok=status.pr_view_ok,
   591	            )
   592	        else:
   593	            ci_failures = 0
   594	
   595	        last_status = status
   596	
   597	        if status.status == "NO_CHECKS":
   598	            return (
   599	                status,
   600	                Decision(
   601	                    action="bail",
   602	                    bail_reason=config.CI_WAIT_BAIL_NO_CHECKS_OBSERVED,
   603	                ),
   604	            )
   605	
   606	        decision = decide(
   607	            status,
   608	            iteration=iteration,
   609	            rebase_count=rebase_count,
   610	            fix_attempts=fix_attempts,
   611	        )
   612	        if decision.action != "wait":
   613	            return status, decision
   614	
   615	        checks += 1
   616	        elapsed = max(0.0, clock() - started_at)
   617	        _warn_stderr(
   618	            f"ci_monitor: poll {checks}/{max_polls} pending after {elapsed:.0f}s; "
   619	            f"sleeping {poll_interval:.0f}s",
   620	        )

   183	def validate_tmpdir(tmpdir: str) -> Path | None:

   185	    if not tmpdir.startswith("/"):

   187	    candidate = Path(tmpdir)

   189	        return None
   190	    canonical = _canonical_dir(candidate)

   193	    basename = canonical.name

Agentic rebase-required is mapped as generic success without a carried rebase or handoff signal	The plan delegates pushes to ci_monitor.stage_and_push and says rebase-required maps to a successful fix result, but current stage_and_push collapses rebase-prep conflicts or push blockers to pushed=False and pending flags, while ship-pr only enters the rebase path when MonitorResult.goto_rebase is true. A delegated fixer that hits rebase-required can be treated as OK without triggering the existing rebase or PrePushConflictHandoff path, or be demoted to waterfall-failed or ci-fix-exhausted.	Define the minimal explicit contract: agentic-fix rebase-required either propagates the existing PrePushConflictHandoff behavior in the parent process or maps in ci_monitor to Outcome.OK with goto_rebase=True and preserved CI_FIX_REBASE_PENDING or conflict detail. Update stage_and_push or the new driver to emit that signal instead of a generic push failure.
